criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: Every batch is on the one list, right on the page: B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, one line each in the dark panel under the header.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is on the board itself — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so a batch goes in without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: The board names itself: an orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER (rgb(224,138,60)).

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list is the first thing under the header — the header ends at y=51 and the batch list starts right below it at y=71, nothing between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH sits to the right of the input, just as drawn — the input runs from x=20 and the button starts at x=1293, at the far right of the row.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the grey 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer.
Your own persistence test ran and went red — it added a batch, restarted, and found the list empty ('the batches were gone after a restart'). The batches do not survive a restart.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen shows an export, and the test run covers only the header and persistence — there is no line about CSV export, so I could not check this either way.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange status line beneath the add row reading the current mix ratio
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches you added to still be there after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the test read back [] where it had put B-1041

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing says nothing about its colour, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a footer, 'grout tracker · sandbox build', at the bottom; the drawing doesn't mention a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
summary: All three PRD goals hold up: the header names the board GROUT TRACKER, every batch is listed on the page, and a new one can be added right there from the add row. Two plan criteria fall short, though — the mix-ratio status line the drawing puts beneath the add row is missing entirely, and your own persistence test ran and failed, so batches don't survive a restart. The CSV export has no screen and no test line, so I couldn't check it.
